Those modes use `--card: #171717` / `#141414` and `--destructive: #ff6568` with **dark** label text (`ui/src/index.css`). The dialog is on light tokens. The dark ring is the scrim/body/terminal, not a second theme on the panel. `WorktreeDeleteDialog` already uses semantic surfaces (`bg-card`, `text-foreground`, `bg-destructive`). There is no `bg-white`. Do not restyle it to a forced dark sheet. ## Defects ### 1. Long path hyphen-wraps in the sentence ```131:134:ui/src/components/WorktreeDeleteDialog.tsx

Review the branch state before deleting {worktree.path}.

``` The screenshot breaks at the product hyphen: `.../orca-` / `lite/.orca-worktrees/...`. The span has no `break-all` / `break-words`. {selectedPath}
``` Original Ferryx delete UI uses the same `break-all` + `bg-muted/35` list box. Smallest fix: keep a short sentence, move `worktree.path` into that boxed `break-all` block.
